<FeatureHeader id="x_live_stats" />

## What it does

Stats in the WebHub and Mini App follow bot activity within about a minute
instead of the next day. A group admin looking at a group's analytics sees
today's numbers exactly, computed live from the raw events; the owner's
`/admin` analytics read the rollups, which the worker now refreshes every
minute. There is nothing to see in the chat itself.

## Behaviour that must not change

v1 had no analytics, so there is no v1 behaviour to preserve. Response shapes
on every analytics endpoint are unchanged, and earlier days still come from the
daily rollups, which the 00:20/00:25 jobs keep closing. Rollup days are UTC,
matching the API windows.

The full behaviour contract lives in [`docs/contracts/x_live_stats.md`](https://github.com/Cookiebot-Team/cookiebot-telegram-bot/blob/main/docs/contracts/x_live_stats.md).

## How to verify it

No Telegram surface, so no acceptance scenario. Integration tests in
`qa/integration/test_analytics.py` cover live-today, no double counting,
live/rollup parity and `Task Count: 1`; the cron table is in
`packages/cb-worker/tests/test_rollup_schedule.py`. By hand: send a message in
a group and reload its analytics within a minute.
